briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 preview sparks AGI timeline debates as US-China chip sanctions tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid record quarterly funding. Geopolitical compute restrictions intensify the race while safety concerns mount over production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI releases Orion-2 preview with multimodal reasoning gains. Anthropic ships Claude 4 Opus while Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3 and Meta open-sources Llama 4. xAI and DeepSeek push parameter efficiency boundaries in latest updates.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins with new red-teaming mandates for frontier labs.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 1M units shipped. Microsoft and Google announce 50GW data center expansions in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent dialect protocols like DialectForge become mandatory for BCI and autonomous vehicle fleets before 2028?
